title: Behind the scenes with Gordon and PCWorld at CES 2019
description:
Follow Gordon, Adam, and Mark around CES and check out some of their silliest moments of the show. Gordon also played too many console games and gave some great thoughts on the year ahead with AMD, Intel, and Nvidia.

Shot on a DJI Osmo Pocket: https://amzn.to/2rKMWTq
